scope: One used arithmetic call-boundary proposal. Static original/current ELF and actual compiled source only; no build, VM, identity gain, or unique historical source claim.

CFG.memory_scope: Explicit stores to these frame slots; all listed slots are scalar or immutable account pointers, outside the callee result buffers. This is not a general alias-analysis proof.

market_cap.r2_curve: Incoming h[0x10] box saved by +0x678/+0x688, reloaded +0x1748 and adjusted +8 at +0x1750; exact helper reads virtual tokens +0x40, virtual quote +0x48, Mayhem bit +0x9a, token_total_supply +0x60.

market_cap.ordering: Call dominates both sell_quote +0x1838 and buy post_fee_amount +0x18e8. The proposed common cap binding belongs before trade_amount, not after it.
market_cap.success: Zero Result<u128> tag; low cap saved -0xac8 and high cap retained r6, then both passed to unchanged get_fees on either branch.
market_cap.failure: Nonzero tag -> +0x1858..+0x1870 copies both Error words unchanged to outer output; no caller source replacement.

sell_sub3.arguments: r2 gross_sell from successful sell_quote +0x1838: low word +0x1840 after high-word zero check +0x1958, stored -0xaf0 by +0x1af0. r3 protocol and r4 creator fees are selected/zeroed by the existing flag branches.

sell_sub3.failure: Other tag -> +0x2710..+0x2728 copies Error discriminant and pointer unchanged to outer output.

buy_sub3.arguments: r2 trade_amount has sole reaching r9 definition +0x19d0 from post_fee_amount successful low value; r3/r4 read actual net_quote_for_budget returned protocol/creator fee fields -0x6c0/-0x6b8. The returned net quote is deliberately recomputed, not substituted.
buy_sub3.success: Tag2 -> +0x1d88 supplies exactly its returned quote to tokens_for_quote and saves the same quote as -0xaf0.
buy_sub3.failure: Same unchanged Error forwarding at +0x2710..+0x2728 as sell.

tokens_for_quote.arguments: r2 same cap curve pointer saved -0xab8; r3 successful buy sub3 quote.
tokens_for_quote.success: Zero Result<u128> tag -> +0x2190; high word admission +0x2198 precedes original u64 truncation and BuyZeroAmount +0x2290, then cap against real_token_reserves.
tokens_for_quote.failure: +0x1dd8..+0x1df8 copies its two Error words unchanged to outer output.
tokens_for_quote.zero_quote: The actual helper performs checked_sub(1); zero converts PumpError::Overflow through the full matched From<PumpError> body, with no caller Source. It replaces the current explicit q!=0 require and effective=q-1 together.

limitations: Static attribution is not compiled caller identity or runtime qualification. Existing rejected Mayhem witness and closed constructor/CTA probes remain separate. Native compilation and replay may only follow one frozen proposal; no variants.
